name: kettlebell rear lunge
description: Step back into a lunge while holding a kettlebell. Stepping backward is kind on the knees and loads the glutes and quads.
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
